summary.text: Becky Laubinger is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 117 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is the executive director of Monarch Family Resource Center.

paragraphs.text: Laubinger earned a bachelor's degree in religious studies from Missouri Baptist University in 1998.
Her career experience includes working as the executive director of Monarch Family Resource Center.

For the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee, the Children and Families Committee, the Legislative Review Committee and the Joint Committee on Public Assistance.
